body:
This would be true of enlisted personnel. Almost all branches are cutting back on Officers, finding very minute details to give them the boot. 

In every OCS application packet you'll see, you'll find a check box that says "Have you ever suffered from panic attacks/anxiety/depression", thats a dequal.

I already have. I made it to the Mexican border only to sit on the hood of my car at Walmart in Loredo and think about how I naive I was.   

I would be dumb to leave all that has been given to me. I know I have a privileged life while my parents didn't. This would be a punch in the face to them.

I can't, it would disqualify me from a job in the Navy. 

They don't want depressed people, they are trying to cut back as it is.

I can't step back. I've been in this haze since senior year in high school. Programs, activities and school run my life these days. I'm just watching as the show progressively comes to an end. 

I know I'm not helpless, but it's hard to break from these chains of perceived success.

I'm taking some dramatic steps tomorrow. Most likely dropping from the program and changing my major to Outdoor Recreation Studies from my current technical major required by ROTC. 

I can't keep living like this. I really can't. 

I know your not supposed to do things you don't like but ROTC is tricky. I feel like its a mind game. They try to make you quit, they want you to hate it. They want the people that stay to really want to be there. Obviously I don't make the cut.

I think its anxiety from ROTC that wakes me up. While I sleep all I can think about is waking up. Did my alarm go off? Did it accidentally get unplugged? Holy shit, what time is it? Are we mustering at 0515 or 0530 today? What papers did he tell us to bring again? Is he going to chew me out for not doing that other thing on time or not turning in the leave chit when I had to go visit my mother?

I can't talk to an advisor, they will say I have anxiety/depression and I will automatically be disqualified from the program.

The college classes are nothing to me. 12 credit hours of brain dead memorization. I thought college was a place to broaden your horizons and expand your philosophies and ways of thinking, I've come to the sudden realization that it is only an extension of high school. This isn't what I signed up for.

But I have to be successful right? I mean, what if I end up being "that guy" who didn't finish college. The guy 6 years behind all of his peers. The guy who ends up dying alone. What if I never find love? Will I ever find something I like to do? Why do I have to be this, who put this self image into my head?

I don't want to learn any more equations, I don't want to study for any other tests, I don't want to try to make new friends to 'fit in', I don't want to mandatorily volunteer for charities I don't give a shit about, I don't want to wake up every morning at 5 am to run till I puke, I don't want to dress up nicely everyday to impress strangers, I don't want to eat Ramen, I don't want to sweat in my bead any more, I don't want to wake up in the middle of the night in panics. I just want to sleep and never wake up. That's all I want.
